verdict.rationale: A state filing and tax-payment service could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring filings or payments, such as auto-pay for annual franchise tax, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only fixed statutory deadlines (annual report due March 1, quarterly estimated-tax installments) and manual online, upload, fax or mail submission. Those are obligation schedules, not a user-configurable recurring job or workflow feature, and the API and agent probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
